candidate_windows.window_text: We choose the hyperparameters for all models following the mentioned previous work. All neural models and the semiCRF were trained on a server with 2 Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU v4@ 2.20GHz, with 4 Nvidia GTX 1080ti graphic cards. To train the joint log-linear model a MacBook Pro 2009 laptop was used. Links to the repositories we use are listed in the complementary material.
